GCF is 6ge^2: 18ge^7 / 6ge^2 = 3e^5 and 24ge^2n^4 / 6ge^2 = 4n^4. C multiplies back but only pulls out 3ge^2, so it isn't fully factored.
Slope -2/3 means the line falls; it crosses the y-axis at 4 and the x-axis at 6. Only C does that (B is too steep, D crosses at -4).
Plug each x into y = -1/2 x + 4: -8 -> 8, -4 -> 6, 2 -> 3, 6 -> 1, 10 -> -1. All of B fits; A fails at x = -6 (should be 7).
Table drops 2 each step from 9: y = 9 - 2x. Line D starts at 9 on the y-axis and hits 0 at x = 4.5.
Graph crosses y at 6 and rises to 10 at x = 20/3, so slope = 4 / (20/3) = 3/5. y = 3/5 x + 6 is Function B.
Table: slope (89 - 50)/(27 - 14) = 3, so y = 3x + 8. Every row of C fits (3*11 + 8 = 41 ...). A is y = 4x + 8.
The statement is y = 4x - 5. A is y = 4x + 5, B is y = -4x - 5, D is y = 1/4 x - 5, so none match.
k has a negative coefficient (-3), so as k goes up, m goes down.
y = -2x + 7: y and x move in opposite directions, so y going up means x going down.
x = 4y - 27, which is 0 at y = 6.75. For y above 7, x is always positive. A fails at y = 6.5 (x = -1).
t has a negative coefficient (-4), so as t goes up, r goes down.
p = 0 at q = 8. p is negative exactly when q is greater than 8.

Top simplifies to C1C2 (the C1J2 terms cancel), so J1 = C1C2/(C2 - 3). Multiply by (C2 - 3) and divide by C2: C1 = J1(C2 - 3)/C2.
Vertex at (1, 4) and opens down: y = -(x - 1)^2 + 4. Check: it crosses the x-axis at -1 and 3, matching the graph.
s = -6t + 8 + 16 = -6t + 24, which is 0 at t = 4. s negative means t > 4, so D is the false statement.
r up 2 means n down 5*2 = 10 (I true). n < 0 means 30 < 5r, so r > 6 (II true). r = 5 gives n = 5, not 0 (III false).
P - Q = 2Q + 6, which changes as Q changes. C fails at Q = -1 (P = 3), and so does D.

Triple the first: 6x + 9y = 51. Subtract the second: 14y = 56, so y = 4 and x = 5/2. Check: 6(5/2) - 5(4) = -5.
Only C has a falling line through 5 (slope -3/4), a rising line through -4 (slope 5/3), and a horizontal line at y = -9. A has a vertical line, B's middle line falls, D's flat line is at +9.
